purpose: Supplemental branch coverage mechanism only; not human gold, P@10, held-out quality, or cross-project acceptance.

cases.notes: A known UI root must not consume the entire window while a disconnected evidenced assembly and its direct dependency are omitted.
All files are weakly connected through a shared dependency, yet the assembly is not directionally reachable from the real mount.
An assembly already reached from a real root keeps its graph position; high rank must not promote it ahead of both first-hop files.
Familiar names, main guards and heuristic assembly hints do not reserve structural lanes despite very high rank.
An evidenced bridge context and one dependency may be read early without being described as a startup root.
When the ten-item window fits the root, two anchors and their first dependencies, one broad UI branch must not starve either uncovered branch.
A downstream assembly with higher rank is not an independent start of an uncovered branch when an upstream evidenced assembly reaches it.
Mutually reachable assembly hints form one structural branch, remain unique and never become distance-zero facts.
A one-item priority window cannot contain all two proven roots and two structural branches; only completeness, true distances and deterministic roots are promised.
